item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Explodes on Steam Charts on Day One
item.description: If players were already hyped for the release of Phantom Blade Zero , their anticipation only grew when the critic reviews were able to secure an average score of 88 on Metacritic , making it the highest-rated action game of the year . It might have been the final push they needed to buy it. On Oct. 29, Phantom Blade Zero became available on digital platforms, and thousands rushed to play it, as is evident from its impressive position on the Steam charts.

item.title: One of Steam’s Best Games of 2026 Is Now a Perfect Mobile Game
item.description: For a few months at the start of 2026, Titanium Court was the year’s worst kept secret. Jury members of the Independent Games Festival couldn’t stop hinting that Consume Me co-developer developer AP Thomson had a very special new game in the works. The lid came off once Titanium Court won the IGF’s coveted Seumas McNally Grand Prize in March and was met with critical buzz when it launched on Windows PC one month later.

item.title: GTA 6's Police Will Hunt You Down with Dogs
item.description: With less than a month to go until its release, fans have learned a fair amount about Grand Theft Auto 6 , and it still seems like they've only gotten to know a small portion of what's coming in this gargantuan game. A recent interview unveiled interesting facts about improved police response, NPC reactions, a dynamic weather system, and realistic public transportation. As more details are revealed, fans are continuously blown away by Rockstar's attention to the small things in the game.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Avatar’s Deepest Episode Has Never Been More Important
item.description: “The Guru” is the penultimate episode of Avatar: The Last Airbender Book 2, and it introduces Guru Pathik (Brian George) as Aang’s (Zachary Tyler Eisen) spiritual guide. After receiving an invitation via Appa, Aang visits the Eastern Air Temple hoping to learn how he can master the Avatar state. Instead, he gets an elaborate lesson on the nature of spiritual energy and its relationship to the chakras . Nearly two decades after its original release, “The Guru” feels even more relevant than ever before.

item.title: New GTA 6 Gameplay Was Shown on South Park, and It Totally Stinks
item.description: Has any game ever been as hotly anticipated as Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto 6 ? We sincerely doubt it. Fans have analyzed every name rumored to be attached to GTA 6 , and calls for more gameplay and content are at an all-time high on social media like Reddit and X, despite the massive amount of leaks that have already shown big portions of the game.

item.title: Fatal Frame Transforms an Ordinary Hobby Into Bone-Chilling Horror
item.description: Fatal Frame creator and director Makoto Shibata once said that the most frightening thing is people's imaginations, which are populated by monsters that we can't see. When designing the first installment of one of the 2000s' most iconic horror series, his desire was to create a game that would make players feel terrified by the mere idea of even grabbing the controller. But the way he got there was unconventional: by making players take photos of ghosts.

item.description: Mortal Kombat is a gruesome game filled with murderous characters that, honestly, should chill out a little. So Brian David Gilbert unraveled which Mortal Kombatant would cuddle the best.

item.title: Which Dark Souls boss is the best manager? | Unraveled
item.description: Dark Souls bosses are dangerous on the battlefield, but can they survive corporate life? Brian David Gilbert unravels and ranks which Dark Souls boss is the best at business leadership.

item.title: 7 Fire Emblem: Three Houses Replay Ideas to Make Garreg Mach Feel Brand New
item.description: Whether you’ve already put hundreds of hours into Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave or you’re waiting until later to pick up a copy, it’s always a good time to revisit Three Houses . Intelligent Systems’ 2019 installment of the strategy RPG series takes place in the same universe as Fortune’s Weave , and there are even a couple of characters who appear in both games.
